fusions.name: Drawn Barb
fusions.desc: A barbed thrust that deals 18 poison damage and draws out every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the hit, then leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Bitter Bloom
fusions.desc: Stinging polyps burst out around you, dealing 12 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 2 tiles. The venom they draw heals you for 20% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Filtered Shallows
fusions.desc: Draws up to 2 poison conditions out of you and your allies and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Lapsed Venom
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted runs out, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You have 10% poison resistance.
